fields.oneLiner: Muhurat turns a wedding photographer's WhatsApp enquiries into one dated list with the wedding date, the price quoted and the next follow-up, so an enquiry does not sit unanswered for three weeks.
fields.jobStory:
When an enquiry lands in a wedding photographer's WhatsApp at 11pm during shoot season, he wants it to end up in one list with the wedding date and the number he quoted, so I can follow up on the fifteen open enquiries he is currently carrying in his head and stop losing a 1.2 lakh booking because he forgot to reply for eighteen days.

Who has this job: wedding photographers in Indore, Bhopal and Jabalpur who shoot 8 to 25 weddings a year, run a two or three person team, and get every enquiry through an Instagram DM that moves to WhatsApp within two messages. They are in the 'MP Wedding Photographers' WhatsApp community, they all shoot at the same four banquet halls, and they tag each other in reels.

What they do instead: they star the WhatsApp chat. Six of the nine photographers I interviewed said 'star the chat' word for word. Two keep a diary with dates. One started a Google Sheet in January and last updated it in March. Every one of them could name at least one booking they lost in the last year purely by not replying, and the two who quoted numbers said 90,000 and 1.6 lakh.
fields.trafficTestNotes:
Three sources, 1 to 11 September 2026.

1. A paid collab post with a wedding-industry meme page on Instagram, 61k followers, 2,500 rupees for one post plus a story. Instagram insights on the post: 24,800 accounts reached, 1,190 profile taps, and the link sticker in the story got 212 taps. 21 signups. Best source by a distance.

2. The 'MP Wedding Photographers' WhatsApp community, about 900 members. I asked the admin first and posted once on 4 Sep with a short video of the list. No view count available so I am reporting what I can see: 63 link clicks from the short link, 16 signups. Free.

3. Google Search ads, 1,800 rupees over six days on keywords like 'wedding photography lead management' and 'photographer CRM India'. 3,400 impressions, 9 clicks, 0 signups. Nothing. I think nobody searches for this because they do not know software for it exists, they only know the problem.

Total spend 4,300 rupees, roughly 284 visits, 37 signups, 13%. The Google result is the useful one even though it returned zero, because it says search is not the channel and the community and the meme page are.
